entry.title: Winter Preseason 2026-2027
entry.summary: Welcome to the Track Preseason. For those that are not in a winter sport and planning to do distance track it is a good idea to build a base to be prepared for the season to start. While it is not mandatory that you follow this plan, the preseason is for building mileage and strength, not for hitting race pace. We will hit race pace when we get to the season and trying to sustain hard workouts for 6 months is too long.
